visual_review.finding: The original scan images for the specified printed pages were inspected. They confirm the local wording and accepted explicit-reference surfaces, but do not resolve the inherited category membership, closed-world absence, list quantifier, or compound-composition blockers.

records.source_location: 事业宫 printed p133 / PDF physical p67
records.printed_source_excerpt: 紫微得百官朝拱，又无煞曜，可以从政，必能发展至部门首脑。若命宫吉者，更主为方面大员，司部长官。
records.direct_scan_finding: The image confirms the continuation from 紫微得百官朝拱、又无煞曜 to the added 命宫吉 qualifier. This span supplies no universal activation threshold for 百官朝拱 and no closed-world evidence contract for absence of 煞曜.
records.reason: The parent condition remains underdetermined. The explicit 命宫吉 continuation does not remove either inherited blocker; do not invent a count/threshold for 百官朝拱 or infer complete absence from an incomplete inventory.

records.source_location: 事业宫 printed p133 / PDF physical p67
records.source_condition_text: 前格从政古称财赋税之官
records.printed_source_excerpt: 若紫微无煞曜同度，却有辅佐吉曜同会，又见禄马交驰，或会廉贞化禄、贪狼化禄、武曲化禄者，主职掌财权，从政亦为财赋税之官。
records.direct_scan_finding: The scan confirms the outer 或 alternative and the three named 化禄 carriers. It does not close the inner list quantifier, enumerate the full 辅佐吉曜 category, or define closed-world absence for 无煞曜同度.
records.reason: The already accepted distinction between outer alternatives and unresolved inner list quantifier remains supported. The parent’s support-category and absence conditions are not made deterministic by this sentence.

records.source_location: 事业宫 printed p134 / PDF physical p67
records.printed_source_excerpt: 若见刑曜，则以从事武职为佳，权力甚重。
records.direct_scan_finding: The scan confirms that 权力甚重 shares the preceding 刑曜 condition. The cited span does not define a closed, universally applicable member set or activation rule for 刑曜.
records.reason: The antecedent link to CA02-107 remains source-supported, but the open category membership/activation blocker remains. Do not promote examples elsewhere into a closed list for this row.

records.source_location: 事业宫 printed p135 / PDF physical p68
records.printed_source_excerpt: [紫相]守事业宫，见吉化，宜从事财经工作。若从商，以资金营运数额巨大者为宜。
records.direct_scan_finding: The scan confirms 若从商 narrows the preceding 财经工作 scene. It does not identify which transformation carrier(s) satisfy 见吉化 or define a source-approved universal activation rule.
records.reason: The source-supported scene qualifier does not resolve the inherited 吉化 activation gap. The target continues to inherit CA02-133’s condition rather than dropping it.

records.source_location: 事业宫 printed p136 / PDF physical p68
records.printed_source_excerpt: 天机化禄，不能改变其不稳定的性质。若吉星祥曜会合，则可能转变到从事有前途的工作。或仅多兼职，或同时从事两三种事业。
records.direct_scan_finding: The scan confirms the multiple-job/parallel-career clauses follow the 天机化禄且吉星祥曜会合 condition. It does not define the members or activation scope of 吉星祥曜.
records.reason: The explicit antecedent remains supported, while the open favorable-star category remains underdetermined. The phrase 两三种事业 is preserved as source wording, not converted into a universal numeric rule.

records.source_location: 事业宫 printed p136 / PDF physical p68
records.printed_source_excerpt: 见空劫、煞耗诸曜者，更属动辄得咎。趋吉避凶之道，在于寻求保守。
records.direct_scan_finding: The image confirms the intensifying clause about 空劫、煞耗诸曜 and the following advice. It does not define group membership, quantifier, or the compound relation required to activate the parent condition.
records.reason: Keep the previously accepted CA02-167 → CA02-166 link and its source-local scope. The visual review adds no evidence for a closed group or deterministic compound composition.

records.source_location: 事业宫 printed p136 / PDF physical p68
records.printed_source_excerpt: 趋吉避凶之道，在于寻求保守，不可为似乎有利的假象所吸引，以致反为失机。
records.direct_scan_finding: The image confirms that the caution against apparently profitable illusions continues the same passage. It does not supply the missing membership or composition semantics for the parent condition.
records.reason: Retain the accepted explicit antecedent CA02-168 → CA02-166; do not generalize it beyond the adjudicated source scope or infer a closed 空劫/煞耗 group.

records.source_location: 事业宫 printed p136 / PDF physical p68
records.printed_source_excerpt: 天机化忌与吉曜同会者，则以从事经纪业为宜。亦可成为代理商。若命宫有太阳化科，则宜代理名牌商品，成为著名字号经纪。
records.direct_scan_finding: The image confirms the additional 命宫太阳化科 qualifier on the brokerage/agency scene. The parent phrase 吉曜同会 remains open-category wording and is not enumerated in this span.
records.reason: The local 命宫太阳化科 qualifier does not remove the inherited 吉曜 membership/activation uncertainty.

records.direct_scan_finding: The scan supports the accepted direct reference to CA02-170 and the transitive dependency on CA02-169. The parent’s 吉曜同会 category remains unspecified; the local continuation does not resolve it.
records.reason: Preserve the accepted two-edge chain CA02-171 → CA02-170 → CA02-169. The local solar-transformation qualifier does not replace or erase the unresolved parent condition.

records.source_location: 事业宫 printed p136 / PDF physical p68
records.printed_source_excerpt: 见煞忌刑耗者，则常转换事业，或转换服务机构，且局面不大。
records.direct_scan_finding: The scan confirms 且局面不大 continues the same clause about career/employer changes under 煞忌刑耗. It does not define the compound group’s members, quantifier, or relation scope.
records.reason: The explicit antecedent to CA02-198 remains supported, but the compound-condition composition remains unresolved. Do not turn the shorthand into an invented ALL/ANY trigger.

records.source_location: 事业宫 printed p137 / PDF physical p69
records.printed_source_excerpt: 若[天机天梁]见禄、权、科会，及辅佐吉曜，则亦可从政，但较难独当一面，且职位调动频仍。
records.direct_scan_finding: The scan confirms that the role limitation follows the 天机天梁见禄权科会及辅佐吉曜 condition. The local source span does not enumerate 辅佐吉曜 or define its contextual activation scope.
records.reason: The accepted antecedent remains supported. The auxiliary-support category remains context-dependent; this audit does not invent its member set or alter other condition axes.
